reason: I already have my Korean place on Keeaumoku and I eat Yu Chun-style naengmyeon back home in Japan, so on a short trip I'd rather go where I know or try something I can't get at home.
objection: I've heard the Japanese branches are just as good, so why spend a vacation meal on the same noodles here, at nearly $19 a bowl plus tax.
would_change_my_mind: Hearing that this Honolulu shop is the original or serves something the Japanese branches don't, like a Hawaii-only dish.
